R/qtl2ggplot

Karl Broman & Brian Yandell

R/qtl2ggplot is a reimplementation of the data visualizations in R/qtl2, which mostly rely on base graphics, to use ggplot2 and related routines.

Installation

You can now install qtl2ggplot direction from CRAN:

install.packages("qtl2ggplot")
